name: GETTING STARTED WITH SPACE MARINES
description:
The Space Marines are genetically enhanced super-soldiers who fight at the forefront of Humanity’s wars. They are stronger, faster, and more resilient than an unaugmented human, and possessed of preternatural reflexes. Doubt, fear, and remorse have no place in their hearts – they are utterly fearless and staunchly loyal to the Imperium.

For the Emperor!

This exciting box is an ideal way to start your Space Marines collection for games of Warhammer 40,000. Space Marines are capable and can easily adapt to a range of situations, making them a versatile force to play. Whether you are an untested neophyte or a seasoned veteran, the book inside will guide you through the process of readying this full Combat Patrol for battle, with easy-to-follow guides for assembling and painting your miniatures. A Warhammer Colour Starter Brush and a selection of paints chosen specifically for Space Marines are included, allowing you to get painting straight away.

This box includes 13 push-fit Space Marines miniatures:
– 1 Captain with Relic Shield
– 1 Librarian
– 5 Intercessors
– 5 Vanguard Veterans
– 1 Land Speeder

The Captain with Relic Shield, Librarian, Vanguard Veterans' Sergeant, and Land Speeder pilots each come with head options, allowing you to build them with a helmet or bare head. The Land Speeder can replace its onslaught gatling cannon with a heavy flamer.

This set contains the following Warhammer Colour paint pots and accessories:
– 1 softcover 36-page Introductory Booklet
– 1 Warhammer Colour Starter Brush
– 1 Texture Spreader
– 1 Abaddon Black (Base)
– 1 Macragge Blue (Base)
– 1 Mournfang Brown (Base)
– 1 Leadbelcher (Base)
– 1 Retributor Armour (Base)
– 1 Corax White (Base)
– 1 Mephiston Red (Base)
– 1 Wraithbone (Base)
– 1 Dawnstone (Layer)
– 1 Nuln Oil (Shade)
– 1 Astrogranite (Texture)

The kit comes supplied with:
– 159 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 105mm by 70mm Oval Hex Hole base
– 2 Citadel 40mm Round Hex Hole bases
– 10 Citadel 32mm Round Hex Hole bases

These push-fit miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
